definition_en: a flat board fixed to a wall or in a frame for holding things, or a ledge of rock under water
core_image: 一块木板钉在墙上，上面排着一列书
scene: 他把书放回架上。He put the book back on the shelf.
sceneCN: 这里 shelf 是「架子」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他把书放回架上。

senses.title: Board
senses.definition: a flat board used to hold things
senses.example: He put the book back on the shelf.
senses.why: This is the basic furniture sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的家具义项。

senses.title: Shelving unit
senses.definition: a set of shelves in a frame
senses.example: The shelf is full of jars.
senses.why: The board stands for the whole unit.

senses.title: Rock ledge
senses.definition: a flat ledge of rock, especially under water
senses.definitionCN: 平坦的岩台，尤指水下的

senses.why: Nature builds shelves too.

senses.title: Put aside
senses.definition: left unused or delayed, as in on the shelf

senses.why: Something on a shelf is set aside for later.

intro.en: Shelf comes from Middle English shelfe, from Old English scylfe, a ledge.
intro.cn: shelf 源自古英语 scylfe（岩台、搁板），中古英语作 shelfe。

items.en: Scylfe meant a ledge or board.
items.cn: scylfe 意为岩台或搁板。

items.en: Shelfe named a board for holding things.
items.cn: shelfe 指放东西的板。

items.en: Shelf named a rock ledge under water.
items.cn: shelf 指水下的岩台。

items.en: Shelf life named how long goods last.
items.cn: shelf life 指商品的保质期。

items.en: On the shelf meant set aside.
items.cn: on the shelf 意为被搁置。

note.en: Shelf is compared with similar-looking words and with words for ledges and racks.

entries.definition: a long flat surface in a shop

normalIntro.en: A shelf is a flat board that holds things, whether on a wall or under the sea.

normal.en: The books are on the top shelf.

abstract.en: A shelf holds things without owning them.

abstract.en: The sea keeps shelves no one can see.

examples.en: He put the book back on the shelf.

core.en: A flat surface that holds things out from a base.

intro.cn: shelf 构成表示家具、储物和延迟的词。

definition_en: a hard outer case, an explosive projectile, to remove such a case, or to attack with shells
core_image: 一只海螺壳贴在耳边，里面传出海的声音
scene: 她在沙滩上捡到一个贝壳。She found a shell on the beach.

senses.title: Hard case
senses.definition: the hard outer covering of an egg, nut, or sea creature
senses.definitionCN: 蛋、坚果或海洋生物的坚硬外壳
senses.example: She found a shell on the beach.
senses.exampleCN: 她在沙滩上捡到一个贝壳。
senses.why: This is the basic natural sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的自然义项。

senses.title: Projectile

senses.title: Remove the case

senses.why: The noun became a verb of removing a case.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为去壳的动词。

senses.title: Bombard
senses.definition: to attack a place with explosive shells

senses.whyCN: 弹体转化为发射它的动作。

intro.en: Shell comes from Old English scell, a hard outer covering.
intro.cn: shell 源自古英语 scell，意为坚硬的外壳。

note.en: Shell is compared with similar-looking words and with words for coverings.

normal.en: The egg shell cracked.

dict_mnemonic.text: shell 源自古英语 scell（硬壳），核心义「包住内部的硬外层」，由蛋壳、贝壳引申为弹壳与炮击。

root: 源自古英语 scell（硬壳），核心义「保护内部的坚硬外层」。

sensesIntro.en: Shell means a hard case, a projectile, to remove a case, or to bombard.

core.en: A hard outside around a softer inside.

branches.en: A natural hard covering.
A metal case filled with explosive.

definition_en: to give out light, to send light onto something, to polish, or to be very good
core_image: 阳光穿过云层，照在刚擦亮的鞋面上
scene: 太阳开始从云层中照出来。The sun began to shine through the clouds.
sceneCN: 这里 shine 是「照耀」（第 2 个义项）；句意：太阳开始从云层中照出来。

senses.title: To give light
senses.definition: to produce bright light
senses.example: Stars shine at night.
senses.why: This is the basic light sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的光义项。

senses.title: To beam
senses.definition: to send light onto something
senses.example: The sun began to shine through the clouds.
senses.exampleCN: 太阳开始从云层中照出来。
senses.why: Light moves from source to surface.
senses.whyCN: 光从光源移到表面。

senses.title: To polish
senses.definition: to rub something until it is bright
senses.example: He shone his shoes before the interview.
senses.why: Polishing makes an object shine.
senses.whyCN: 擦拭使物体发亮。

senses.title: To excel
senses.definition: to be very good at something
senses.example: She shines in mathematics.
senses.why: Brightness becomes social excellence.
senses.whyCN: 明亮引申为出众。

intro.en: Shine goes back to an ancient word for giving out light.
intro.cn: shine 可追溯到表示发出光亮的古老词根。

items.en: Scinan meant to give out light.
items.cn: scinan 意为发出光。

items.en: Skeinijanan carried the same shining sense.
items.cn: skeinijanan 带有同样的发光含义。

items.en: Shinen kept the sense of glowing.
items.cn: shinen 保留了发光的含义。

items.en: Shine added the senses of polishing and excelling.
items.cn: shine 增加了擦亮与出众的含义。

items.en: Take a shine to became a common phrase.
items.cn: take a shine to 成为常用短语。

note.en: Shine is compared with similar-looking words and with words for light.
note.cn: 把 shine 与形近词以及表示光的词作比较。

to give a steady soft light
to shine with a weak light

examples.en: Stars shine at night.

items.meaning: a bruised eye or an excellent person

definition_en: a large boat for sea travel, to transport goods, or to release a product
core_image: 一艘货船驶出港口，甲板上堆满集装箱
scene: 那艘船驶入了港口。The ship sailed into the harbour.
sceneCN: 这里 ship 是「船」（第 1 个义项）；句意：那艘船驶入了港口。

senses.title: Vessel
senses.definition: a large boat for carrying people or goods at sea
senses.definitionCN: 在海上运送人或货物的大型船
senses.example: The ship sailed into the harbour.
senses.why: This is the basic nautical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的海上义项。

senses.title: To transport
senses.definition: to send goods by ship or another carrier
senses.definitionCN: 用船或其他运输工具发送货物
senses.example: The company ships orders every morning.
senses.exampleCN: 公司每天早上发出订单。
senses.why: The vessel becomes the act of sending.
senses.whyCN: 船引申为运送的动作。

senses.title: To release
senses.definition: to make a product available to customers
senses.example: The studio will ship the game next month.
senses.exampleCN: 工作室下个月将发布这款游戏。
senses.why: Software borrowed the transport image.
senses.whyCN: 软件业借用了运输的意象。

senses.title: To send away
senses.definition: to send someone somewhere, often quickly
senses.definitionCN: 把某人送往某处，常指迅速
senses.example: The manager shipped him off to the new office.
senses.exampleCN: 经理把他打发到新办公室去了。

senses.whyCN: 运货引申为送人。

core_image: 一封信从手中滑落，读信的人僵在原地，脸色发白
scene: 消息让所有人震惊。The news shocked everyone.
sceneCN: 这里 shock 是「使震惊」（第 1 个义项）；句意：消息让所有人震惊。

senses.title: To surprise
senses.definition: to surprise someone very much, often unpleasantly
senses.definitionCN: 使某人非常意外，常指不愉快地
senses.example: The news shocked everyone.
senses.why: This is the main verb sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是主要的动词义项。

senses.title: A sudden upset
senses.definition: a sudden strong feeling caused by bad news
senses.definitionCN: 坏消息引起的突然强烈感受
senses.example: She was in shock after the call.
senses.why: The noun names the state after the blow.
senses.whyCN: 名词指打击后的状态。

senses.title: Electric jolt
senses.definition: a sudden flow of electricity through the body
senses.example: He got a shock from the wire.
senses.why: Electricity delivers a literal jolt.
senses.whyCN: 电带来的是字面意义上的冲击。

senses.title: Medical shock
senses.definition: a dangerous condition with low blood flow
senses.example: The patient went into shock.
senses.why: Physical shock can follow injury.
senses.whyCN: 身体受伤后可能出现休克。

intro.en: Shock comes from French choc, a blow, from choquer, to strike.
intro.cn: shock 来自法语 choc（打击），源头是 choquer（撞击）。

items.en: Choquer meant to strike or collide.
items.cn: choquer 意为撞击或相撞。

items.en: Choc named a military clash or blow.
items.cn: choc 指军事冲突或打击。

items.en: Shock named a sudden violent blow.
items.cn: shock 指突然的猛烈打击。

items.en: Shock extended to mental surprise.
items.cn: shock 扩展到心理上的意外。

items.en: Shock named electric and medical conditions.
items.cn: shock 指电击与医学休克。

note.en: Shock is compared with similar-looking words and with words for surprise and blows.
note.cn: 把 shock 与形近词以及表示惊讶和冲击的词作比较。

entries.definition: to make someone feel sudden wonder
to shock someone so much they cannot react
a sudden hard movement or shock

normalIntro.en: Shock is a blow that arrives without warning, to the body or to the mind.
normalIntro.cn: shock 是没有预兆到来的打击，落到身体或心上。

normal.en: The news shocked us all.
normal.cn: 这消息让我们全都震惊。

normal.en: She was too shocked to speak.
Never touch a wire with a shock risk.
normal.cn: 绝不要碰有电击风险的电线。

normal.en: The team suffered a culture shock abroad.
normal.cn: 球队在国外遭遇文化冲击。

normal.en: He went into shock after the fall.

abstract.en: Shock is the moment before understanding.
abstract.cn: 震惊是理解到来之前的瞬间。

abstract.en: A blow to the mind can numb the body.
abstract.cn: 对心的打击能让身体麻木。

abstract.en: Electricity and bad news both travel fast.
abstract.cn: 电流与坏消息都传播得很快。

examples.en: The news shocked everyone.
He got a shock from the wire.
The patient went into shock.

dict_mnemonic.text: shock 原义是「撞击」：坏消息撞心、电流撞身、伤后身体崩溃，都是同一记重击。

root: 源自古法语 choquer（撞击），核心义「突如其来的重击」。

sensesIntro.en: Shock means to surprise, a sudden upset, an electric jolt, or a medical collapse.
sensesIntro.cn: shock 意为使震惊、震惊、电击或休克。

core.en: A sudden blow with no warning.
core.cn: 毫无预兆的突然打击。

branches.en: News hits the mind.
The mind freezes after the hit.
Current hits the body.
The body collapses after injury.
Words and electricity both strike.

intro.en: Shock forms a family of surprise and impact words.
intro.cn: shock 形成一个表示惊讶与冲击的词族。

latinIntro.en: Shock has no Latin ancestor; Latin percutere, to strike, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: shock 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 percutere（打击）只是语义对应词。

items.example: We were shocked by the price.
The final score was a shocker.

items.meaning: a smaller shock after an earthquake

definition_en: a covering for the foot, a metal plate for a horse's hoof, or another person's situation
core_image: 一双旧皮鞋整齐摆在门口，鞋底还沾着泥
scene: 她把湿鞋放在门边。She left her wet shoes by the door.
sceneCN: 这里 shoe 是「鞋」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她把湿鞋放在门边。

senses.title: Footwear
senses.definition: a covering worn on the foot
senses.example: She left her wet shoes by the door.
senses.why: This is the basic sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本义项。

senses.title: Horseshoe
senses.definition: a metal plate nailed to a horse's hoof
senses.example: The blacksmith fitted a new shoe.
senses.exampleCN: 铁匠装上了一块新马蹄铁。
senses.why: The foot covering extends to horses.
senses.whyCN: 脚上的覆盖物扩展到马。

senses.title: Someone's place
senses.definition: another person's situation or position
senses.definitionCN: 另一个人的处境或位置
senses.example: Try walking in her shoes for a day.
senses.exampleCN: 试着设身处地体会她的一天。
senses.why: Standing in shoes becomes standing in a life.
senses.whyCN: 站在鞋里引申为站在别人的人生里。

intro.en: Shoe comes from an Old English word for a foot covering.
intro.cn: shoe 来自古英语中表示脚部覆盖物的词。

items.en: Scoh meant a covering for the foot.
items.cn: scoh 意为脚的覆盖物。

items.en: Skokhaz carried the same footwear sense.
items.cn: skokhaz 带有同样的鞋类含义。

items.en: Shoe named leather footwear for people.
items.cn: shoe 指人的皮鞋。

items.en: Shoe extended to metal plates for horses.
items.cn: shoe 扩展到马的金属蹄铁。

items.en: In someone's shoes became an idiom.
items.cn: in someone's shoes 成为习语。

note.en: Shoe is compared with similar-looking words and with other footwear.
note.cn: 把 shoe 与形近词以及其他鞋类作比较。

normalIntro.en: A shoe is a small house for a foot, and sometimes a metal house for a hoof.
normalIntro.cn: shoe 是脚的小房子，有时也是马蹄的金属小房子。

normal.en: Put on your shoes.
These shoes are too tight.
The horse lost a shoe.
He polishes his shoes every night.
Try being in her shoes.
normal.cn: 试着设身处地体会她的处境。

abstract.en: Shoes remember every road walked.
abstract.cn: 鞋记得走过的每一条路。

abstract.en: To know a person, borrow their shoes.
abstract.cn: 了解一个人，就借他的鞋穿一穿。

abstract.en: Even a horse needs help to stand well.
abstract.cn: 就连马也需要帮助才能站得稳。

examples.en: She left her wet shoes by the door.
The blacksmith fitted a new shoe.
examples.cn: 铁匠装上了一块新马蹄铁。

examples.en: Try walking in her shoes for a day.
examples.cn: 试着设身处地体会她的一天。

dict_mnemonic.text: shoe 的核心是「套在脚外的东西」：人的鞋、马的蹄铁；站进别人的鞋里，就是站进别人的处境。

root: 源自古英语 scoh（脚的覆盖物），核心义「脚的外壳」。

sensesIntro.en: Shoe means footwear, a horseshoe, or another person's situation.
sensesIntro.cn: shoe 意为鞋、马蹄铁或他人的处境。

core.en: A protective covering around the foot.
core.cn: 包住脚的防护性覆盖物。

branches.en: A pair waits by the door.
A horse wears a metal shoe.
Standing in another's place.
People and horses both wear shoes.
The same word covers footwear and empathy.
branches.cn: 同一个词涵盖鞋与共情。

intro.en: Shoe forms a family of footwear and walking words.
intro.cn: shoe 形成一个表示鞋类与行走的词族。

latinIntro.en: Shoe has no Latin ancestor; Latin calceus, shoe, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: shoe 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 calceus（鞋）只是语义对应词。

items.meaning: a string for fastening a shoe
a metal plate for a horse
items.example: A horseshoe hung above the door.
items.exampleCN: 门上方挂着一块马蹄铁。

definition_en: a place where goods are sold, to buy things, or a workshop for repairs
core_image: 街角的小店亮着暖黄的灯，橱窗里摆满商品
scene: 街角的商店很早就开门。The shop on the corner opens early.
sceneCN: 这里 shop 是「商店」（第 1 个义项）；句意：街角的商店很早就开门。

senses.title: A store
senses.definition: a building or room where goods are sold
senses.definitionCN: 出售商品的建筑或房间
senses.example: The shop on the corner opens early.
senses.exampleCN: 街角的商店很早就开门。
senses.why: This is the basic British sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的英式义项。

senses.title: To buy
senses.definition: to go to shops to buy things
senses.example: We shopped all afternoon.
senses.why: The place turns into an activity.
senses.whyCN: 地点转为活动。

senses.title: A workshop
senses.definition: a place where things are made or repaired
senses.definitionCN: 制造或修理物品的地方
senses.example: The car is in the repair shop.
senses.why: An old sense survives in repair shop.
senses.whyCN: 古老义项保留在 repair shop 中。

intro.en: Shop comes from an Old English word for a booth or shed.
intro.cn: shop 来自古英语中表示摊位或棚屋的词。

items.en: Sceoppa meant a booth or shed.
items.cn: sceoppa 意为摊位或棚屋。

items.en: Shoppe named a place where goods were sold.
items.cn: shoppe 指出售商品的地方。

items.en: Shop became the standard British word for a store.
items.cn: shop 成为英式英语中表示商店的标准词。

items.en: Shop became a verb meaning to buy.
items.cn: shop 成为表示购物的动词。

items.en: Repair shop kept the workshop sense.
items.cn: repair shop 保留了车间义。

note.en: Shop is compared with similar-looking words and with words for stores.
note.cn: 把 shop 与形近词以及表示商店的词作比较。

entries.definition: a shop, especially in American English
a place where people buy and sell

normalIntro.en: A shop is a small stage where goods wait for buyers.
normalIntro.cn: shop 是商品等待买家的小舞台。

normal.en: The shop closes at six.
She shops every Saturday.
The shop window is full of cakes.
We shopped around for a cheaper phone.
normal.cn: 我们货比三家找更便宜的手机。

normal.en: The bike is at the repair shop.

abstract.en: A shop window is a promise made of glass.
abstract.cn: 橱窗是用玻璃做出的承诺。

abstract.en: Shopping is a walk with a list.
abstract.cn: 购物是带着清单的散步。

abstract.en: Small shops remember their customers.
abstract.cn: 小商店记得自己的顾客。

examples.en: The shop on the corner opens early.
examples.cn: 街角的商店很早就开门。

examples.en: We shopped all afternoon.
The car is in the repair shop.

dict_mnemonic.text: shop 原指小棚子：棚子里卖东西就是商店，去棚子里买就是购物，修东西的棚子就是车间。

root: 源自古英语 sceoppa（棚屋、摊位），核心义「卖货或干活的小场所」。

sensesIntro.en: Shop means a store, to buy things, or a workshop.
sensesIntro.cn: shop 意为商店、购物或车间。

core.en: A small place where goods change hands.
core.cn: 商品易手的小场所。

branches.en: A store on the corner.
An afternoon spent buying.
A place where repairs happen.
Selling and repairing both happen in a shop.
branches.cn: 卖货与修理都在 shop 里发生。

branches.en: The place and the activity share one word.
branches.cn: 地点与活动共用一个词。

intro.en: Shop forms a family of buying and working words.
intro.cn: shop 形成一个表示买卖与工作的词族。

latinIntro.en: Shop has no Latin ancestor; Latin taberna, shop, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: shop 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 taberna（店铺）只是语义对应词。

items.meaningCN: 商店（复数）；购物（第三人称单数）
items.example: The street is full of small shops.
items.exampleCN: 这条街到处都是小商店。

items.meaning: a room for making or repairing

definition_zh: 短的；短暂的；短缺的；矮的
definition_en: not long, lasting a little time, not having enough, or not tall
core_image: 一根短铅笔捏在手里，只剩一小截还能写
scene: 会议很短，二十分钟就结束了。The meeting was short and ended in twenty minutes.
sceneCN: 这里 short 是「短的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：会议很短，二十分钟就结束了。

senses.title: Not long
senses.definition: small in length or distance
senses.example: The meeting was short and ended in twenty minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 会议很短，二十分钟就结束了。
senses.why: Length is the basic physical sense.
senses.whyCN: 长度是基本的物理义项。

senses.title: Brief
senses.definition: lasting only a little time
senses.example: We had a short break.
senses.why: Length in space becomes length in time.
senses.whyCN: 空间长度转为时间长度。

senses.title: Lacking
senses.definition: not having enough of something
senses.example: We are short of chairs.
senses.why: Falling short of a need means lacking.
senses.whyCN: 未达到需要就是短缺。

senses.title: Not tall
senses.definition: small in height
senses.example: He is short but strong.
senses.why: A small vertical measure is short.
senses.whyCN: 纵向尺寸小也是 short。

intro.en: Short comes from an Old English word for cut off or brief.
intro.cn: short 来自古英语中表示截短或简短之词。

items.en: Sceort meant short or brief.
items.cn: sceort 意为短的或简短的。

items.en: Skurtaz carried the same length sense.
items.cn: skurtaz 带有同样的长度含义。

items.en: Short described length, time, and height.
items.cn: short 形容长度、时间与高度。

items.en: Short of meant lacking something.
items.cn: short of 意为缺少某物。

items.en: In short became a common phrase.
items.cn: in short 成为常用短语。

note.en: Short is compared with similar-looking words and with words for brevity and lack.
note.cn: 把 short 与形近词以及表示简短和缺乏的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Short is any measure that stops sooner than expected.
normalIntro.cn: short 是任何比预期更早停止的尺度。

normal.en: She has short hair.
We took a short break.
We are short of time.
He is short but quick.
In short, the plan works.
normal.cn: 简而言之，这个计划可行。

abstract.en: A short answer can still be complete.
abstract.cn: 简短的回答也可以是完整的。

abstract.en: Short cuts often hide longer roads.
abstract.cn: 捷径常常藏着更长的路。

abstract.en: Being short of something teaches its value.
abstract.cn: 缺少某物才懂得它的价值。

examples.en: The meeting was short and ended in twenty minutes.
examples.cn: 会议很短，二十分钟就结束了。

examples.en: We are short of chairs.
He is short but strong.

dict_mnemonic.text: short 的核心是「不够长」：长度短、时间短、东西不够、个子不高，全是不达标。

root: 源自古英语 sceort（短），核心义「长度或时间不足」。

sensesIntro.en: Short means not long, brief, lacking, or not tall.
sensesIntro.cn: short 意为短的、短暂的、短缺的或矮的。

core.en: A measure that falls below the expected line.
core.cn: 低于预期线的尺度。

branches.en: A pencil worn down to a stub.
A meeting over in minutes.
Not enough chairs for guests.
A person who stands low.
Not long enough becomes not enough.

intro.en: Short forms a large family of length and lack words.
intro.cn: short 形成一个庞大的长度与缺乏词族。

latinIntro.en: Short has no Latin ancestor; Latin brevis, short, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: short 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 brevis（短）只是语义对应词。

items.example: We took a shortcut through the park.

definition_en: used to give advice or express duty, expectation, a possible condition, or regret
core_image: 一只手指轻轻点在路标上，指着该走的方向
scene: 你应该早点休息。You should rest earlier.
sceneCN: 这里 should 是「应该」（第 1 个义项）；句意：你应该早点休息。

senses.title: Duty or advice
senses.definition: used to say what is right or advisable
senses.definitionCN: 用于说明正确或可取的做法
senses.example: You should rest earlier.
senses.why: This is the everyday advice sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是日常提建议的义项。

senses.title: Expectation
senses.definition: used to say what is likely to happen
senses.definitionCN: 用于说明可能发生的事
senses.example: She should be home by now.
senses.why: The duty sense softens into probability.
senses.whyCN: 义务义项弱化为可能性。

senses.title: A condition
senses.definition: used after if to describe a possible situation
senses.definitionCN: 用于 if 之后描述可能的情况
senses.example: Should it rain, we will stay inside.
senses.exampleCN: 要是下雨，我们就待在屋里。
senses.why: The modal moves to the front in formal conditionals.
senses.whyCN: 在正式条件句中，情态动词移到句首。

senses.title: Regret
senses.definition: used with have to describe something not done
senses.definitionCN: 与 have 连用，描述本该做却没做的事
senses.example: You should have called me.
senses.why: The past form points backward at a missed duty.
senses.whyCN: 过去形式回指一项被错过的义务。

intro.en: Should began as the past tense of an old verb meaning to owe.
intro.cn: should 最初是一个意为「欠」的古老动词的过去式。

items.en: Sculan meant to owe or to be obliged.
items.cn: sculan 意为欠债或有义务。

items.en: Sceolde was its past tense form.
items.cn: sceolde 是它的过去式形式。

items.en: Should became the past tense of shall.
items.cn: should 成为 shall 的过去式。

items.en: It grew into the chief modal of advice.
items.cn: 它发展为表示建议的主要情态动词。

items.en: The conditional and regret uses became fixed.
items.cn: 条件与遗憾用法逐渐固定下来。

note.en: Should is compared with similar-looking words and with other modal verbs.
note.cn: 把 should 与形近词以及其他情态动词作比较。

entries.definition: the joint between neck and arm

normalIntro.en: Should is a small push toward the right action or the likely result.
normalIntro.cn: should 是朝正确做法或很可能的结果轻轻一推。

normal.en: You should drink more water.
She should be home by now.
Should it rain, we will stay inside.
normal.cn: 要是下雨，我们就待在屋里。

normal.en: You should have called me.
We should leave before dark.
normal.cn: 我们应该在天黑前出发。

abstract.en: Should is duty speaking in a quiet voice.
abstract.cn: should 是用轻声说话的责任。

abstract.en: Should turns a guess into an expectation.
abstract.cn: should 把猜测变成预期。

abstract.en: Should have is the shadow of a missed choice.
abstract.cn: should have 是错过选择的影子。

examples.en: You should rest earlier.
The train should arrive soon.
You should have told the truth.

dict_mnemonic.text: should 原是「欠」的过去式：欠着一件事没做，就是应该做；欠着一个结果，就是将会发生。

root: 源自古英语 sculan（欠、有义务）的过去式 sceolde，核心义「被义务或情理推着走」。

sensesIntro.en: Should marks advice, expectation, a possible condition, or regret.
sensesIntro.cn: should 表示建议、预期、可能条件或遗憾。

core.en: A gentle force pointing toward what is right or likely.
core.cn: 指向正确或可能之事的温和力量。

branches.en: You owe a kind action to yourself.
The likely result is close.
branches.cn: 很可能的结果就在眼前。

branches.en: A condition waits in the first word.
branches.cn: 条件藏在句首的第一个词里。

branches.en: A past duty was left undone.
Duty and likelihood share one modal.
branches.cn: 义务与可能性共用一个情态动词。

intro.en: Should has a small family of modal and contraction forms.
intro.cn: should 有一个由情态形式和缩略形式组成的小词族。

latinIntro.en: Should is Germanic; Latin debere, to owe, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: should 属日耳曼语；拉丁语 debere（欠）只是语义对应词。

items.example: Visitors should not touch the wire.

definition_en: the joint between the neck and arm, to carry a burden, the edge of a road, or to push with the shoulder
core_image: 背包带压在肩上，人微微侧身把重量扛住
scene: 他把包甩到肩上。He swung the bag onto his shoulder.
sceneCN: 这里 shoulder 是「肩膀」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他把包甩到肩上。

senses.title: The body joint
senses.definition: the part of the body where the arm joins the neck and back
senses.definitionCN: 手臂与颈部和背部相连的身体部位
senses.example: He swung the bag onto his shoulder.
senses.why: This is the basic body-part sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的身体部位义项。

senses.title: To bear a burden
senses.definition: to accept responsibility for something difficult
senses.example: She shouldered the blame alone.
senses.why: The body part becomes a metaphor for carrying.
senses.whyCN: 身体部位转化为承载的隐喻。

senses.title: The road edge
senses.definition: the strip of ground beside a road
senses.example: The car stopped on the shoulder.
senses.why: The shoulder sits at the edge, like the body part.
senses.whyCN: 路肩位于边缘，正如肩膀在身体两侧。

senses.title: To push through
senses.definition: to push forward using the shoulder
senses.example: He shouldered his way to the front.
senses.why: The joint becomes a tool for force.
senses.whyCN: 关节变成了施力的工具。

intro.en: Shoulder is an ancient Germanic body-part word.
intro.cn: shoulder 是一个古老的日耳曼语身体部位词。

items.en: Sculdor named the shoulder.
items.cn: sculdor 指肩膀。

items.en: Sholder replaced the older spelling.
items.cn: sholder 取代了更早的拼写。

items.en: The body sense stayed stable for centuries.
items.cn: 身体义项数百年保持稳定。

items.en: The verb came to mean to carry or bear.
items.cn: 动词义发展为承载或承担。

items.en: Road builders borrowed the word for the edge.
items.cn: 道路修建者借用该词表示路边。

note.en: Shoulder is compared with similar-looking words and with words for body parts and burdens.
note.cn: 把 shoulder 与形近词以及表示身体部位和负担的词作比较。

entries.definition: the rear part of the body

normalIntro.en: The shoulder is the body's shelf and lever.
normalIntro.cn: 肩膀是身体的托架和杠杆。

normal.en: He swung the bag onto his shoulder.
She shouldered the blame alone.
The car stopped on the shoulder.
They stood shoulder to shoulder.
He shouldered his way to the front.

abstract.en: A shoulder is where strength meets closeness.
abstract.cn: 肩膀是力量与亲近相遇的地方。

abstract.en: To shoulder a burden is to make it smaller.
abstract.cn: 扛起负担，负担就变小了。

abstract.en: The road's shoulder is the body's shoulder in stone.
abstract.cn: 路肩是石头做成的身体肩膀。

examples.en: He swung the bag onto his shoulder.
She shouldered the blame alone.
The car stopped on the shoulder.

dict_mnemonic.text: 肩膀能扛包，也能扛责任；路的两侧像肩膀，所以路边叫路肩。

root: 源自古英语 sculdor（肩膀），核心义「身体两侧可承重的关节部位」。

sensesIntro.en: Shoulder means the body joint, to bear a burden, a road edge, or to push through.
sensesIntro.cn: shoulder 意为肩膀、承担、路肩或用肩挤。

core.en: The strong side joint that carries and pushes.
core.cn: 位于体侧、用于承载和推挤的强壮关节。

branches.en: The arm meets the body.
The joint carries what is heavy.
branches.cn: 这个关节承载沉重之物。

branches.en: The road has its own sides.
The joint becomes a pushing tool.
Carrying a bag and carrying blame feel the same.
branches.cn: 扛包与扛责任的感觉相同。

intro.en: Shoulder builds compounds about carrying and body shape.
intro.cn: shoulder 构成表示承载与体型的复合词。

latinIntro.en: Shoulder is Germanic; Latin umerus, shoulder, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: shoulder 属日耳曼语；拉丁语 umerus（肩）只是语义对应词。

items.exampleCN: 一个宽肩膀的男人走了进来。

items.meaning: a strap worn over the shoulder
a bag carried on one shoulder

definition_zh: 喊叫；呼喊声；喝斥；请客喝饮料
definition_en: to say something very loudly, a loud cry, to speak angrily, or to buy someone a drink
core_image: 一个人双手拢在嘴边，朝远处用力喊话
scene: 别在图书馆里大喊。Do not shout in the library.
sceneCN: 这里 shout 是「喊叫」（第 1 个义项）；句意：别在图书馆里大喊。

senses.title: To call loudly
senses.definition: to say something in a very loud voice
senses.example: Do not shout in the library.
senses.why: This is the central action sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是核心的动作义项。

senses.title: A loud cry
senses.definition: a loud call or cry
senses.example: We heard a shout from the hill.
senses.exampleCN: 我们听到山上传来一声呼喊。
senses.why: The action turns into a countable event.
senses.whyCN: 动作转化为可计数的事件。

senses.title: To speak angrily
senses.definition: to speak sharply or angrily to someone
senses.definitionCN: 严厉或愤怒地对某人说话
senses.example: He shouted at the driver.
senses.why: Loudness becomes a sign of anger.
senses.whyCN: 大声变成了愤怒的标志。

senses.title: To treat someone
senses.definition: to buy a drink or meal for someone
senses.example: I will shout you a coffee.
senses.why: A friendly British and Australian use of the word.
senses.whyCN: 这是英式和澳式英语中的友好用法。

intro.en: Shout has an uncertain origin, perhaps from an old Norse taunt.
intro.cn: shout 的词源不确定，可能来自古诺尔斯语中表示嘲弄的词。

items.en: Skuta may have meant a taunt or a call.
items.cn: skuta 可能意为嘲弄或呼喊。

items.en: Shouten meant to call out loudly.
items.cn: shouten 意为大声呼喊。

items.en: The noun shout named a loud cry.
items.cn: 名词 shout 指响亮的喊声。

items.en: Angry speech became a common sense.
items.cn: 愤怒的说话方式成为常见义项。

items.en: British and Australian English added the treating sense.
items.cn: 英式和澳式英语增添了请客义项。

note.en: Shout is compared with similar-looking words and with words for loud calls.
note.cn: 把 shout 与形近词以及表示大声呼喊的词作比较。

entries.definition: to give a loud high cry

normalIntro.en: A shout is a voice pushed across a distance.
normalIntro.cn: shout 是把声音推向远处的力量。

normal.en: Do not shout in the library.
We heard a shout from the hill.
normal.cn: 我们听到山上传来一声呼喊。

normal.en: He shouted at the driver.
She shouted for help.
I will shout you a coffee.

abstract.en: A shout is a voice that refuses distance.
abstract.cn: 喊叫是拒绝距离的声音。

abstract.en: Anger often arrives before the words do.
abstract.cn: 愤怒常常先于词语到达。

abstract.en: A friendly shout can be warmer than a whisper.
abstract.cn: 友好的招呼可能比耳语更温暖。

examples.en: Do not shout in the library.
She shouted for help.
We heard a shout from the hill.
examples.cn: 我们听到山上传来一声呼喊。

dict_mnemonic.text: shout 把嘴巴变成喇叭：喊出去的是声音，喊回来的是回应。

root: 可能源自古诺尔斯语 skuta（嘲弄、呼喊），核心义「把声音用力送出去」。

sensesIntro.en: Shout means to call loudly, a loud cry, to speak angrily, or to treat someone.
sensesIntro.cn: shout 意为大声喊叫、呼喊声、喝斥或请客。

core.en: A voice thrown with force toward someone far away.
core.cn: 用力把声音投向远处的人。

branches.en: The voice rises to reach far.
branches.cn: 声音提高以便传得更远。

branches.en: The call becomes a sound in the air.
branches.cn: 呼唤变成空气中的声响。

branches.en: Loudness carries anger.
A call can also be a friendly offer.
branches.cn: 呼唤也可以是一次友好的邀请。

branches.en: Volume alone cannot tell anger from joy.
branches.cn: 仅凭音量无法区分愤怒与喜悦。

intro.en: Shout builds a small family of calling and noise words.
intro.cn: shout 构成一个表示呼喊与噪声的小词族。

latinIntro.en: Shout is Germanic; Latin clamare, to cry out, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: shout 属日耳曼语；拉丁语 clamare（呼喊）只是语义对应词。

items.example: The coach shouts from the side.
The shouter stood at the gate.
He gave a shout-out to his teacher.
items.exampleCN: 他公开感谢了他的老师。

items.example: No one could outshout the crowd.
items.exampleCN: 没人能喊得比人群更响。

definition_en: to let someone see something, to prove or make clear, or a performance or display
core_image: 幕布拉开，舞台灯光把一切摊在观众眼前
scene: 她把照片给大家看。She showed the photo to everyone.
sceneCN: 这里 show 是「展示」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她把照片给大家看。

senses.title: To display
senses.definition: to let someone see something
senses.example: She showed the photo to everyone.
senses.why: This is the basic visual sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的视觉义项。

senses.title: To make clear
senses.definition: to prove or make something clear
senses.example: The test showed that he was right.
senses.why: Showing something makes it visible to reason.
senses.whyCN: 展示某物就是让它对理性可见。

senses.title: A performance
senses.definition: a play, concert, or other public performance
senses.definitionCN: 戏剧、音乐会或其他公开演出
senses.example: We saw a show at the theatre.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在剧院看了一场演出。
senses.why: The noun grew from something put before an audience.
senses.whyCN: 名词义源于呈现在观众面前的东西。

senses.title: An exhibition
senses.definition: a public display of objects or art
senses.definitionCN: 物品或艺术的公开展示
senses.example: The flower show opens on Friday.
senses.why: Objects, like performances, are shown to the public.
senses.whyCN: 物品和演出一样，都是向公众展示的。

intro.en: Show comes from an old word meaning to look at.
intro.cn: show 来自一个意为「看」的古老词。

items.en: Sceawian meant to look at or inspect.
items.cn: sceawian 意为观看或察看。

items.en: Shewen came to mean to display.
items.cn: shewen 逐渐表示展示。

items.en: The verb added the sense to prove.
items.cn: 动词增添了证明的义项。

items.en: The noun named a public performance.
items.cn: 名词指公开演出。

items.en: Exhibitions and broadcasts widened the noun.
items.cn: 展览与广播扩大了名词的用法。

note.en: Show is compared with similar-looking words and with words for displaying.
note.cn: 把 show 与形近词以及表示展示的词作比较。

entries.definition: a fall of rain or a wash
to put something where it can be seen

normalIntro.en: To show is to move something from hidden to seen.
normalIntro.cn: show 就是把东西从看不见的地方移到看得见的地方。

normal.en: She showed the photo to everyone.
The test showed that he was right.
We saw a show at the theatre.
normal.cn: 我们在剧院看了一场演出。

normal.en: The flower show opens on Friday.
He showed me around the city.
normal.cn: 他带我参观了这座城市。

abstract.en: A show is a secret given light.
abstract.cn: 演出是重见光明的秘密。

abstract.en: To show is to lend your eyes to another.
abstract.cn: 展示就是把你的眼睛借给别人。

abstract.en: Proof is a fact put on stage.
abstract.cn: 证据是被搬上舞台的事实。

examples.en: She showed the photo to everyone.
The test showed that he was right.
We saw a show at the theatre.
examples.cn: 我们在剧院看了一场演出。

dict_mnemonic.text: show 的核心是「让人看见」：给人看照片是展示，让证据被看见是表明，把节目摆上台是演出。

root: 源自古英语 sceawian（看、察看），核心义「使某物进入视线」。

sensesIntro.en: Show means to display, to make clear, a performance, or an exhibition.
sensesIntro.cn: show 意为展示、表明、演出或展览。

core.en: Moving something from hidden into sight.
core.cn: 把某物从隐蔽处移到视线中。

branches.en: The object is offered to the eyes.
The fact is made visible to reason.
People gather to watch.
Objects stand still for viewing.
Display and performance share one act of showing.
branches.cn: 展示与演出共享同一个呈现动作。

intro.en: Show builds a family of display and performance words.
intro.cn: show 构成表示展示与表演的词族。

latinIntro.en: Show is Germanic; Latin monstrare, to show, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: show 属日耳曼语；拉丁语 monstrare（展示）只是语义对应词。

items.example: The film was shown last night.

items.meaning: a glass case for displaying goods
items.example: The rings are in the showcase.
He is a bit of a show-off.

items.exampleCN: 演艺经理介绍了这个节目。

definition_zh: 淋浴；阵雨；送礼聚会；大量给予
definition_en: a wash under falling water, a short fall of rain, a party for giving gifts, or to give many things
core_image: 花洒喷出细密水线，热气在浴室里升起
scene: 他每天早上冲个淋浴。He takes a shower every morning.
sceneCN: 这里 shower 是「淋浴」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他每天早上冲个淋浴。

senses.title: A wash
senses.definition: a wash under a spray of falling water
senses.example: He takes a shower every morning.
senses.why: This is the everyday bathroom sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是日常浴室场景中的义项。

senses.title: A rain
senses.definition: a short fall of rain
senses.example: A shower passed over the town.
senses.why: Falling water connects rain and washing.
senses.whyCN: 落下的水流把雨和淋浴联系起来。

senses.title: A gift party
senses.definition: a party where gifts are given, especially for a baby or a bride
senses.definitionCN: 赠送礼物的聚会，尤指为婴儿或新娘举办
senses.example: They held a baby shower for her.
senses.exampleCN: 他们为她办了一场迎婴聚会。
senses.why: Gifts fall on the guest like rain.
senses.whyCN: 礼物像雨一样落在客人身上。

senses.title: To give much
senses.definition: to give someone many things or much attention
senses.definitionCN: 给某人许多东西或大量关注
senses.example: Fans showered her with flowers.
senses.why: The rain image turns into an abundance of gifts.
senses.whyCN: 雨的意象转化为礼物的丰盛。

intro.en: Shower first meant a brief fall of rain.
intro.cn: shower 最初意为一阵短暂的降雨。

items.en: Scur meant a brief storm or shower.
items.cn: scur 意为短暂的暴风雨或阵雨。

items.en: Shour named a fall of rain.
items.cn: shour 指一阵降雨。

items.en: The washing sense appeared with indoor plumbing.
items.cn: 随着室内管道出现，淋浴义项产生了。

items.en: A party for giving gifts took the name.
items.cn: 赠送礼物的聚会沿用了这个词。

items.en: The verb came to mean to give in large amounts.
items.cn: 动词义发展为大量给予。

note.en: Shower is compared with similar-looking words and with words for washing and rain.
note.cn: 把 shower 与形近词以及表示洗浴和降雨的词作比较。

entries.definition: a wash in a tub of water

normalIntro.en: A shower is rain invited indoors, or gifts falling like rain.
normalIntro.cn: shower 是被请进室内的雨，或像雨一样落下的礼物。

normal.en: He takes a shower every morning.
A shower passed over the town.
They held a baby shower for her.
normal.cn: 他们为她办了一场迎婴聚会。

normal.en: Fans showered her with flowers.
The showerhead is broken.

abstract.en: A shower is rain that agrees to stay in one room.
abstract.cn: 淋浴是愿意留在一个房间里的雨。

abstract.en: Gifts can fall as softly as warm rain.
abstract.cn: 礼物可以像暖雨一样轻轻落下。

abstract.en: Kindness often arrives in showers, not drops.
abstract.cn: 善意常常成阵而来，而非一滴一滴。

examples.en: He takes a shower every morning.
A shower passed over the town.
Fans showered her with flowers.

dict_mnemonic.text: shower 本来是「一阵雨」：水从上往下落，落在身上是淋浴，落在礼物上就是大量赠送。

root: 源自古英语 scur（短暂风雨、阵雨），核心义「从上方落下的一阵水或物」。

sensesIntro.en: Shower means a wash, a short rain, a gift party, or to give in large amounts.
sensesIntro.cn: shower 意为淋浴、阵雨、送礼聚会或大量给予。

core.en: Water or gifts falling from above in a short burst.
core.cn: 水或礼物从上方短促地落下。

branches.en: Water falls on a standing body.
Clouds release a brief rain.
Friends gather to give gifts.
branches.cn: 朋友们聚在一起送礼物。

branches.en: Gifts and praise pour down.
Rain and generosity share the same falling shape.
branches.cn: 雨与慷慨共享同一种下落形态。

intro.en: Shower builds a small family of rain and bathroom words.
intro.cn: shower 构成表示降雨与浴室用品的小词族。

latinIntro.en: Shower is Germanic; Latin imber, a rain shower, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: shower 属日耳曼语；拉丁语 imber（阵雨）只是语义对应词。

items.meaning: a brief rain or a wash

items.exampleCN: 他很快洗了澡穿好衣服。

items.example: The shower gel smells of lemon.

items.meaning: a cap that keeps hair dry

definition_en: to close something, to stop operating, to block, or to keep someone or something inside
core_image: 一扇门被轻轻带上，锁舌咔哒一声扣住
scene: 请把门关上。Please shut the door.
sceneCN: 这里 shut 是「关上」（第 1 个义项）；句意：请把门关上。

senses.title: To close
senses.definition: to close a door, window, or container
senses.example: Please shut the door.
senses.why: This is the basic physical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的物理义项。

senses.title: To stop operating
senses.definition: to close a business or machine
senses.example: The factory shut last month.
senses.why: A closed place stops working like a closed door.
senses.whyCN: 关闭的场所像关上的门一样停止运作。

senses.title: To block
senses.definition: to block an opening or a view
senses.example: The curtain shuts out the light.
senses.why: Closing can mean keeping something out.
senses.whyCN: 关闭也可以表示把某物挡在外面。

senses.title: To confine
senses.definition: to keep someone or something inside
senses.definitionCN: 把某人或某物关在里面
senses.example: They shut the dog in the yard.
senses.why: Closing can also keep something in.
senses.whyCN: 关闭也可以表示把某物关在里面。

intro.en: Shut comes from an Old English verb for bolting a door.
intro.cn: shut 来自古英语中表示给门上门闩的动词。

items.en: Scyttan meant to bolt or bar a door.
items.cn: scyttan 意为给门上门闩或横闩。

items.en: Shutten widened to mean to close.
items.cn: shutten 扩大为表示关闭。

items.en: The word covered windows and containers.
items.cn: 这个词覆盖了窗户和容器。

items.en: Businesses could shut for the day.
items.cn: 企业可以当天停业。

items.en: Shut in and shut out split the idea of closure.
items.cn: shut in 与 shut out 分化了关闭的方向。

note.en: Shut is compared with similar-looking words and with words for closing.
note.cn: 把 shut 与形近词以及表示关闭的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: To shut is to make an opening stop being open.
normalIntro.cn: shut 就是让一个开口不再敞开。

normal.en: Please shut the door.
The factory shut last month.
The curtain shuts out the light.
They shut the dog in the yard.
Shut the window before you leave.

abstract.en: A shut door is a promise of privacy.
abstract.cn: 关上的门是隐私的承诺。

abstract.en: Shutting out noise can be a kindness.
abstract.cn: 把噪声挡在外面也可以是一种善意。

abstract.en: Some doors must shut before others open.
abstract.cn: 有些门必须先关上，别的门才会打开。

examples.en: Please shut the door.
The factory shut last month.
The curtain shuts out the light.

dict_mnemonic.text: shut 的核心是「合上」：门合上是关门，厂子合上是停业，帘子合上就把光挡在外面。

root: 源自古英语 scyttan（上门闩），核心义「合拢、封闭开口」。

sensesIntro.en: Shut means to close, to stop operating, to block, or to confine.
sensesIntro.cn: shut 意为关上、停业、挡住或关住。

core.en: Closing an opening so that passage stops.
core.cn: 合上开口，使通行停止。

branches.en: The door meets its frame.
The business stops its work.
Light and sound stay outside.
What is inside stays inside.
Closing works in both directions.
branches.cn: 关闭在两个方向上都起作用。

intro.en: Shut builds a family of closure words.
intro.cn: shut 构成表示封闭的词族。

latinIntro.en: Shut is Germanic; Latin claudere, to close, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: shut 属日耳曼语；拉丁语 claudere（关闭）只是语义对应词。

items.meaning: a closing of a business or machine
a person who rarely goes out
items.exampleCN: 这位闭门不出的人需要陪伴。

items.meaning: a game where one side scores nothing
items.example: The team won by a shutout.
items.exampleCN: 这支球队零封对手获胜。

definition_en: ill, feeling nausea, or tired of something
core_image: 一个人裹着毯子躺在床上，脸色发白
scene: 他今天没来上学，因为他病了。He is sick and did not come to school today.
sceneCN: 这里 sick 是「生病的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他今天病了，没有来上学。

senses.title: Ill
senses.definition: not healthy; suffering from an illness
senses.example: He is sick and stays in bed.
senses.why: This is the basic health sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的健康义项。

senses.title: Feeling nausea
senses.definition: feeling that you want to vomit
senses.example: The smell made me sick.
senses.why: The stomach sense grew out of illness.
senses.whyCN: 胃部不适的义项由生病延伸而来。

senses.title: Tired of something
senses.definition: bored or annoyed with something
senses.example: I am sick of waiting.
senses.why: Repeated annoyance feels like a kind of illness.
senses.whyCN: 反复的厌烦像一种心理上的病。

intro.en: Sick is an old English word for illness.
intro.cn: sick 是一个表示疾病的古老英语词。

items.en: Seoc meant ill or diseased.
items.cn: seoc 意为生病的、有病的。

items.en: The form became sik.
items.cn: 词形演变为 sik。

items.en: The spelling settled as sick.
items.cn: 拼写固定为 sick。

items.en: The sense widened to nausea.
items.cn: 词义扩大到恶心想吐。

items.en: Informal slang gave it the sense of excellent.
items.cn: 口语俚语又赋予它「极好」的意思。

note.en: Sick is compared with similar-looking words and with other words for illness.
note.cn: 把 sick 与形近词以及其他表示疾病的词作比较。

entries.definition: a soft covering for the foot

normalIntro.en: Sick points at the body, the stomach, and the patience.
normalIntro.cn: sick 可以指向身体、胃和耐心三个方面。

normal.en: He is sick and stays in bed.
The smell made me sick.
I am sick of waiting.
She felt sick on the boat.
Sick children stayed home.

abstract.en: A sick body teaches the mind patience.
abstract.cn: 生病的身体教会心灵耐心。

abstract.en: Nausea is the stomach writing a warning.
abstract.cn: 恶心是胃写下的警告。

abstract.en: Being sick of something is a kind of tiredness.
abstract.cn: 对某事厌倦也是一种疲惫。

examples.en: He is sick and stays in bed.
The smell made me sick.
I am sick of waiting.

dict_mnemonic.text: sick 记住三个方向：身体生病、胃里恶心、心里厌烦；一个词管三处不适。

root: 源自古英语 sēoc（有病的），核心义「身体不适」。

sensesIntro.en: Sick means ill, feeling nausea, or tired of something.
sensesIntro.cn: sick 意为生病的、恶心的或厌倦的。

core.en: The body out of balance.
core.cn: 身体失去平衡。

branches.en: Illness keeps him in bed.
A smell turns the stomach.
Waiting wears patience thin.
Both senses involve the body.
branches.cn: 前两个义项都关乎身体。

branches.en: Discomfort can be physical or mental.
branches.cn: 不适可以是身体上的，也可以是心理上的。

intro.en: Sick forms a family of illness words.
intro.cn: sick 形成一个表示疾病的词族。

latinIntro.en: Sick is Germanic; Latin aeger, sick, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: sick 属日耳曼语；拉丁语 aeger（有病的）只是语义对应词。

items.exampleCN: 他一夜之间病得更重了。

items.example: She was the sickest child in the ward.
items.exampleCN: 她是病房里病得最重的孩子。

items.example: The sickness passed in a week.
The sickly plant needed more light.
items.exampleCN: 这株病弱的植物需要更多光照。

items.meaning: the bed of a sick person

items.example: He took two days of sick leave.

definition_en: a surface at the left or right, an aspect, or one group in a dispute
core_image: 一个立方体翻过来，露出旁边另外一面
scene: 他指着房间的一侧，请人把箱子搬过去。Please move the box to this side.
sceneCN: 这里 side 是「一边」（第 1 个义项）；句意：请把箱子搬到这一边。

senses.title: A surface at the left or right
senses.definition: one of the surfaces or positions to the left or right
senses.example: Please move the box to this side.
senses.why: This is the basic spatial sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的空间义项。

senses.title: An aspect
senses.definition: one part of a situation or problem
senses.definitionCN: 情况或问题的一个方面
senses.example: We must look at every side of the problem.
senses.exampleCN: 我们必须看问题的每个方面。
senses.why: A thing has sides in space and in thought.
senses.whyCN: 事物在空间中有侧面，在思考中也有方面。

senses.title: One group in a dispute
senses.definition: one of the groups taking part in an argument or game
senses.definitionCN: 争论或比赛中参与的一方
senses.example: Both sides agreed to talk.
senses.why: People line up on opposite sides like two edges.
senses.whyCN: 人分站两边，就像两条边。

intro.en: Side once meant the flank of the body.
intro.cn: side 最初指身体的侧面。

items.en: Side meant a flank or a long edge.
items.cn: side 意为肋部或长边。

items.en: The related word sitha also meant side.
items.cn: 相关词 sitha 同样表示侧面。

items.en: The word spread to land, rooms, and roads.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到土地、房间和道路。

items.en: The sense of aspect appeared.
items.cn: 「方面」的义项出现了。

items.en: The sense of a team or party appeared.
items.cn: 「一方、队伍」的义项出现了。

note.en: Side is compared with similar-looking words and with words for edges.
note.cn: 把 side 与形近词以及表示边缘的词作比较。

entries.definition: a place where something is or happens

normalIntro.en: Side is always the part beside you.
normalIntro.cn: side 永远是身旁的那一面。

normal.en: Please move the box to this side.
They sat side by side.
Both sides agreed to talk.
The shop is on the other side.
He took my side in the argument.

abstract.en: Every coin has two sides.
abstract.cn: 每枚硬币都有两面。

abstract.en: A side is a door into a whole.
abstract.cn: 一个侧面是通向整体的门。

abstract.en: To choose a side is to choose a story.
abstract.cn: 选边站就是选择一个故事。

examples.en: Please move the box to this side.
We must look at every side of the problem.
examples.cn: 我们必须看问题的每个方面。

examples.en: Both sides agreed to talk.

dict_mnemonic.text: side 的核心是旁边那一面：路的两旁是 side，争论的两边也是 side。

root: 源自古英语 side（肋部、侧面），核心义「旁边的一面」。

sensesIntro.en: Side means a surface at the left or right, an aspect, or one party.
sensesIntro.cn: side 意为侧面、方面或一方。

core.en: The face beside the main face.
core.cn: 主面旁边的那个面。

branches.en: A box has six sides.
A problem has many sides.
Two sides meet to talk.
Space and thought both have sides.
The physical edge becomes a team.

intro.en: Side builds words for edges, paths, and directions.
intro.cn: side 构成表示边缘、路径和方向的词。

latinIntro.en: Side is Germanic; Latin latus, side, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: side 属日耳曼语；拉丁语 latus（侧面）只是语义对应词。

items.example: The side of the house is white.

items.meaning: an extra result of a medicine
items.example: The drug has few side effects.
items.exampleCN: 这种药几乎没有副作用。

items.meaning: a smaller street off a main road
items.example: They parked on a side street.

items.meaning: showing only one point of view

items.example: The two houses stand side by side.

definition_en: a mark with a meaning, a fact showing something, or a notice board
core_image: 门上一块木牌，白字写着方向
scene: 门上挂着一块牌子，上面写着「推」。The sign on the door says Push.
sceneCN: 这里 sign 是「招牌、告示牌」（第 3 个义项）；句意：门上的牌子写着「推」。

senses.title: A mark with meaning
senses.definition: a mark or symbol that carries a meaning
senses.definitionCN: 带有含义的记号或符号
senses.example: The plus sign means add.
senses.why: This is the basic symbolic sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的符号义项。

senses.title: A fact showing something
senses.definition: something that shows a fact or a likely event
senses.definitionCN: 表明某个事实或可能发生之事的现象
senses.example: There is no sign of rain.
senses.why: Facts act like marks that point to more.
senses.whyCN: 事实就像指向更多信息的记号。

senses.title: A notice board
senses.definition: a board or notice that gives information or a warning
senses.definitionCN: 提供信息或警告的牌子
senses.example: The sign on the door says Push.
senses.why: A board is a large public mark.
senses.whyCN: 牌子是一种大型的公共记号。

intro.en: Sign comes from the Latin word for a mark.
intro.cn: sign 来自拉丁语中表示记号的那个词。

items.en: Signum meant a mark or token.
items.cn: signum 意为记号或标志。

items.en: The word passed into French as signe.
items.cn: 这个词以 signe 的形式进入法语。

items.en: English borrowed it as signe.
items.cn: 英语借入时写作 signe。

items.en: The spelling became sign.
items.cn: 拼写变为 sign。

items.en: The verb use meant to write one's name.
items.cn: 动词用法表示写下自己的名字。

note.en: Sign is compared with similar-looking words and with words for marks.
note.cn: 把 sign 与形近词以及表示记号的词作比较。

entries.definition: to make music with the voice
a mark that stands for something
a sign of what will happen

normalIntro.en: A sign is a small mark that points beyond itself.
normalIntro.cn: sign 是一个指向自身之外的记号。

normal.en: The sign on the door says Push.
There is no sign of rain.
The plus sign means add.
He signed his name at the bottom.
The driver missed the stop sign.

abstract.en: A sign is a finger pointing at meaning.
abstract.cn: 记号是指向意义的一根手指。

abstract.en: Small marks carry large agreements.
abstract.cn: 小小的记号承载着重要的约定。

abstract.en: What we notice becomes a sign.
abstract.cn: 被我们注意到的东西就成了迹象。

examples.en: The sign on the door says Push.
There is no sign of rain.
He signed his name at the bottom.

dict_mnemonic.text: sign 的核心是「记号」：小记号是符号，指向事实是迹象，挂在门上就是招牌。

root: 源自拉丁语 signum（记号、标志），核心义「有含义的记号」。

sensesIntro.en: Sign means a meaningful mark, a sign of a fact, or a notice board.
sensesIntro.cn: sign 意为有含义的符号、迹象或告示牌。

core.en: A visible mark that points to something else.
core.cn: 指向他物的可见记号。

branches.en: A plus sign stands for addition.
Dark clouds are a sign of rain.
A board tells people what to do.
branches.cn: 牌子告诉人们该怎么做。

branches.en: Both senses point beyond the mark.
branches.cn: 这两个义项都指向记号之外。

branches.en: Public marks turn facts into warnings.
branches.cn: 公共记号把事实变成警告。

intro.en: Sign builds a large family of marking and meaning words.
intro.cn: sign 构成一个表示标记与含义的大家族。

latinIntro.en: Sign comes through French from Latin signum, a mark.
latinIntro.cn: sign 经由法语来自拉丁语 signum（记号）。

items.example: The sign was easy to read.
The signing took place at noon.

items.meaning: a sign that gives a message

items.example: Her signature is hard to copy.
The signpost points to the lake.

definition_en: the state of not speaking or making sound, or to make someone quiet
core_image: 空荡的礼堂里，连一根针落地都听得见
scene: 老师一进门，教室里立刻安静下来。Silence fell when the teacher entered.
sceneCN: 这里 silence 是「寂静」（第 2 个义项）；句意：老师一进门，教室里立刻安静下来。

senses.title: Not speaking
senses.definition: the state of saying nothing
senses.example: They ate in silence.
senses.why: This is the basic human sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的人际义项。

senses.title: Complete quiet
senses.definition: the state of having no sound at all
senses.example: Silence fell when the teacher entered.
senses.exampleCN: 老师一进门，教室里立刻安静下来。
senses.why: The quiet of a place matches the quiet of a person.
senses.whyCN: 地方的安静与人的沉默相对应。

senses.title: To make quiet
senses.definition: to stop someone from speaking or making sound
senses.definitionCN: 使某人不说话或不出声
senses.example: The teacher silenced the class.
senses.why: The noun turned into an action.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化成了动作。

intro.en: Silence comes from a Latin word for being still.
intro.cn: silence 来自表示静止的拉丁语词。

items.en: Silere meant to be still or silent.
items.cn: silere 意为保持静止或沉默。

items.en: Silentium meant silence.
items.cn: silentium 意为寂静。

items.en: The word entered French as silence.
items.cn: 这个词以 silence 进入法语。

items.en: English borrowed it as silence.
items.cn: 英语借入时写作 silence。

items.en: The verb use meant to make quiet.
items.cn: 动词用法表示使安静。

note.en: Silence is compared with similar-looking words and with words for quiet.
note.cn: 把 silence 与形近词以及表示安静的词作比较。

entries.definition: the state of not moving or sounding

normalIntro.en: Silence is what fills a room when sound leaves it.
normalIntro.cn: 声音离开房间后，填满房间的就是 silence。

normal.en: Silence fell when the teacher entered.
normal.cn: 老师一进门，教室里立刻安静下来。

normal.en: They ate in silence.
She broke the silence with a question.
normal.cn: 她用一个问题打破了沉默。

normal.en: We stood for a moment of silence.
The teacher silenced the class.

abstract.en: Silence is a sound made of nothing.
abstract.cn: 沉默是一种由虚无构成的声音。

abstract.en: What is not said can be the loudest message.
abstract.cn: 没有说出口的话可能是最响的信息。

abstract.en: Quiet rooms hold clear thoughts.
abstract.cn: 安静的房间装着清晰的思绪。

examples.en: Silence fell when the teacher entered.
examples.cn: 老师一进门，教室里立刻安静下来。

examples.en: They ate in silence.
The teacher silenced the class.

dict_mnemonic.text: silence 与 silent 同根：人不说话是沉默，地方没声音是寂静，让人闭嘴就是使安静。

root: 源自拉丁语 silentium（寂静），来自 silere（保持安静），核心义「无声」。

sensesIntro.en: Silence means not speaking, complete quiet, or the act of making quiet.
sensesIntro.cn: silence 意为沉默、寂静或使安静。

core.en: The absence of voice and sound.
core.cn: 人声与声响的缺席。

branches.en: They say nothing to each other.
The room holds no sound.
The teacher stops the noise.
A person and a place can both be silent.
branches.cn: 人和地方都可以是安静的。

branches.en: Stillness can be made or kept.
branches.cn: 安静既可以被造成，也可以被维持。

intro.en: Silence builds a family of quiet words.
intro.cn: silence 构成表示安静的词族。

latinIntro.en: Silence comes from Latin silentium, from silere, to be still.
latinIntro.cn: silence 来自拉丁语 silentium，源于 silere（保持安静）。

items.exampleCN: 他的眼神让房间安静下来。

items.meaning: a device that makes a gun quieter

items.example: They held a moment of silence.

definition_en: not speaking, making no sound, or not pronounced
core_image: 一个人把手指放在唇上，四周静得能听见呼吸
scene: 整场会议他都很沉默。He remained silent during the whole meeting.
sceneCN: 这里 silent 是「沉默的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：整场会议他都很沉默。

senses.title: Not speaking
senses.definition: saying nothing
senses.example: He remained silent during the whole meeting.
senses.why: This is the basic human sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的人际义项。

senses.title: Making no sound
senses.definition: having no sound
senses.example: The house was silent at night.
senses.why: A place can be silent as well as a person.
senses.whyCN: 地方和人一样可以安静。

senses.title: Not pronounced
senses.definition: written but not spoken, as a letter in a word
senses.definitionCN: 写出来却不发音，如单词中的某个字母
senses.example: The b in doubt is silent.
senses.exampleCN: doubt 中的 b 不发音。
senses.why: A letter can stay silent too.
senses.whyCN: 字母也可以保持沉默。

intro.en: Silent comes from a Latin word meaning still.
intro.cn: silent 来自一个意为静止的拉丁语词。

items.en: Silere meant to be still.
items.cn: silere 意为保持安静。

items.en: Silentem meant being still or silent.
items.cn: silentem 意为安静的。

items.en: The word entered French as silent.
items.cn: 这个词以 silent 进入法语。

items.en: English borrowed it as silent.
items.cn: 英语借入时写作 silent。

items.en: It also described films without sound.
items.cn: 它也用来形容没有声音的电影。

note.en: Silent is compared with similar-looking words and with words for quiet.
note.cn: 把 silent 与形近词以及表示安静的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Silent means the voice has stopped.
normalIntro.cn: silent 表示声音停了下来。

normal.en: He remained silent during the whole meeting.
The house was silent at night.
The b in doubt is silent.
normal.cn: doubt 中的 b 不发音。

normal.en: We watched a silent film.
normal.cn: 我们看了一部无声电影。

normal.en: The crowd fell silent.

abstract.en: Silent people often hear the most.
abstract.cn: 沉默的人常常听得最多。

abstract.en: A silent room can speak loudly.
abstract.cn: 寂静的房间也能大声说话。

abstract.en: Some letters are written but never heard.
abstract.cn: 有些字母写出来却从不出声。

examples.en: He remained silent during the whole meeting.
The house was silent at night.
We watched a silent film.
examples.cn: 我们看了一部无声电影。

dict_mnemonic.text: silent 与 silence 同根：人不出声是沉默，地方没声音是寂静，字母不发音也用它。

root: 源自拉丁语 silentem（安静的），来自 silere（保持安静），核心义「不出声」。

sensesIntro.en: Silent means not speaking, making no sound, or not pronounced.
sensesIntro.cn: silent 意为沉默的、寂静的或不发音的。

core.en: The voice switched off.
core.cn: 人声被关掉的状态。

branches.en: He says nothing all meeting.
The night holds no sound.
One letter stays unheard.
People and places share the quiet.
Silence can be seen in writing.
branches.cn: 沉默也能在书写中看到。

intro.en: Silent belongs to the silence family of quiet words.
intro.cn: silent 属于 silence 这一安静词族。

latinIntro.en: Silent comes from Latin silentem, from silere, to be still.
latinIntro.cn: silent 来自拉丁语 silentem，源于 silere（保持安静）。

items.example: The silencing of dissent is wrong.
